title: SEC-TESTS: bt5.10 msgid normalization test missing insert-then-lookup roundtrip
description: The test case_insensitive_msgid_duplicate_detected (transit/src/peering/ingestion.rs line 286) tests that offering '<ABC@example.com>' after inserting '<abc@example.com>' returns Duplicate. This is a good test for duplicate detection. However the test manually inserts the normalized (lowercase) key directly via map.insert('<abc@example.com>', &cid). It does NOT test whether the ingestion pipeline itself normalizes the key on INSERT. If the normalization only happens on LOOKUP (not on INSERT), an article inserted as '<ABC@example.com>' would be stored under that key and subsequent offers of '<abc@example.com>' would miss. The test needs a companion: insert via the full pipeline (check_ingest with uppercase msgid), then offer the lowercase variant, and verify Duplicate is returned. Oracle: the two message-id strings '<ABC@example.com>' and '<abc@example.com>' are known test vectors; Duplicate is the only correct result per RFC 5536.
